remarks:
Pride of ownership shows on this lovely 3 bedroom 1 bath Cape style home in heart of Cheektowaga, in the
desirable Maryvale School District! This home is situated in a wonderful neighborhood, boasting maintenance
free siding, newer roof, 1.5 car garage, and a great sized fully fenced in backyard! Walk through the front door
where you will find the spacious living room featuring vinyl flooring throughout and great natural light. The
kitchen was fully remodeled in 2021 and it is absolutely stunning; featuring great size, modern cabinets /
countertops, newer appliances, backsplash + much more!! There is a spacious mudroom off the kitchen which
features 1st floor laundry, great storage space, and a man door leading out to the fully fenced in backyard. The
first floor features 2 spacious bedrooms both featuring great size, ample closet space, lvp flooring, and modern
paint throughout. The full bathroom features lvp flooring, tile surround, tub, and modern fixtures throughout.
Don't forget to check out the upstairs offering a spacious 3rd bedroom. Off of the 3rd bedroom, is the unfinished
attic which serves for great storage space, this space also gives you the option to potentially expand the living
space where you could make an additional bedroom, bathroom, or whatever suites your needs, the opportunities
are endless!! Not only is this home move in ready, but the mechanicals are solid! Newer roof, high efficiency
furnace, central air, newer hot water tank, & updated electrical. This home was also apart of the Quieter Home
Program in 2013; all new windows 2 pane sound absorbent interlayers in additional insulation blown into walls
and steel front and back door. Showings begin immediately.
